institution: ICAR-Central Tuber Crops Research Institute (CTCRI) Thiruvananthapuram
problem_solved: Difficulty in transporting and marketing perishable tropical tuber crops and farmers' produce
description: The multipurpose mobile starch extractor is designed to address the challenges associated with the perishable nature of tropical tuber crops and the difficulties in long-distance transportation and marketing. The machine enables in-situ production of starch and value addition near the farm site, helping farmers process their produce locally and reduce post-harvest constraints.
applications:
Cassava and tropical tuber crop processing enterprises
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and agricultural cooperatives
Agri-entrepreneurs and rural value-addition startups
Starch manufacturing and food ingredient industries
Government-supported agro-processing and post-harvest management programs
